name: TIME GAL Re:birth
source:
Time Gal Re:birth is a sequel to the classic Taito LaserDisc arcade game Time Gal. It stars a new protagonist, Luna, who travels through time in pursuit of the villain from the original game. This is primarily a story-based visual novel, but gameplay is periodically interrupted by QTE action sequences that play much like the original game.

[from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/240750/time-gal-rebirth/]MobyGames[/url]]

Time Gal Re:birth is a sequel to the classic Taito LaserDisc arcade game Time Gal. It stars a new protagonist, Luna, who travels through time in pursuit of the villain from the original game. This is primarily a story-based visual novel, but gameplay is periodically interrupted by QTE action sequences that play much like the original game.
